text:
Alex Rivera: Quick heads-up — OrionHealth goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. We'll be on bridgewatch for 24h starting 08:30 to catch warmups. This is a VIP SLA contract: 99.9% availability and p50 latency target 200ms.

Maria Chen: Thanks. Expected traffic shape?

Alex Rivera: They said bursty bursts from the registration flow. Estimate ~1.5–2.2M tokens/min for the first 2 hours, then sustained ~600–800k tokens/min for the day. Main risk is token-level concurrency causing longer tail latencies on hosted tier.

Sam Patel: We'll route them to the dedicated pool (rd-dedicated-orion). Autoscale policy should handle sustained, but the initial spike might push queue depth. I recommend pre-warming 6 extra instances and enabling the small-model fallback to reduce tail.

Lee Gomez: Will prefix KV cache be useful here? Their onboarding prompts are repetitive.

Maria Chen: Yes — we should prewarm KV caches for the common onboarding prompts. I'll run a cache warmup job at 07:45 PT with a saved prompt set. Also enabling prefix cache TTL=6h.

Alex Rivera: Oncall action items:
- @Maria take cache warmup job (07:45 PT)
- @Sam prewarm 6 instances and set autoscale min=8
- @Lee watch batching metrics and adjust batch size if p95 > 800ms
- @Jamal cover pager between 08:30–14:30 PT (bridgewatch) then hand back

Jamal Singh: I can take the 08:30–14:30 slot. Will be pingable on mobile.

oncall-bot: Reminder set — bridgewatch rotation for OrionHealth (08:30 PT -> 08:30 PT next day). Pager escalation: 10m -> 30m -> 60m.

Sam Patel: Quick note on fallbacks: please make sure the model variant mapping includes quantized v2-8bit and the safe-output filter. If we hit token overload, route to quantized variant to preserve throughput.

Maria Chen: For alerts, can we lower the latency alert threshold for the Orion route to p95 > 750ms (5min window) and token-inflight > 40k? I want earlier signal.

Alex Rivera: Agree. Set two alerts: latency p95 > 750ms (5m) and queue depth > 35k (2m). Ops-sched, can you apply?

ops-sched: Applied: updated route alerts for "orion-launch". Latency p95=750ms/5m, queue depth=35k/2m. Notified incident channel as well.

Lee Gomez: Also added a quick dashboard tile for per-route token-rate and avg-batch-size. Link: https://console.redwood/instruments/orion-launch (check perms).

Maria Chen: If SLA breach looks imminent, escalate to account team + product leadership immediately — we have remediation credits in the contract.

Alex Rivera: Final: I'll be available until 10:30 PT then intermittent. Tag me in threads if anything noisy. Thanks team — try to keep messages brief in the bridgewatch channel so oncall notifications don't get buried. :thumbsup:

Jamal Singh: Copy. I'll do a mid-coverage summary message at 11:30 PT.

oncall-bot: Coverage note posted to #eng-oncall: OrionHealth bridgewatch started by Alex Rivera."
